strength.label: Catalogue strength
strength.text: Ford’s MY26.50-labelled Trend LWB catalogue lists a windowless bulkhead with a load-through hatch and eight load tie-down loops.

tradeoff.label: Worth weighing
tradeoff.text: It lists manual driver-seat adjustment and single-zone climate control; the Sport SWB catalogue lists a power-adjustable driver seat and dual-zone climate.

strength.label: Catalogue strength
strength.text: Ford’s MY26.50-labelled Sport SWB catalogue lists a 10-way power-adjustable driver seat and dual-zone climate control.

tradeoff.label: Worth weighing
tradeoff.text: Dual sliding side doors and a rear liftgate are extra-cost factory options; the standard catalogue arrangement has one left sliding door and rear barn doors.
